prompt: Explain why ocean tides happen and why the Moon has a stronger tidal effect on Earth than the Sun despite the Sun being more massive.
model_response: Ocean tides result from differential gravity creating bulges; the Moon’s tide is stronger because tidal force ∝ M/r^3 and its much smaller r outweighs the Sun’s larger M, yielding roughly twice the solar effect
correct_answer: Ocean tides are mainly caused by gravitational differences across Earth and the Moon has a stronger tidal effect because it is much closer than the Sun

prompt: Explain why seasons occur on Earth.

correct_answer: Seasons occur because Earths axis is tilted causing different hemispheres to receive different angles and durations of sunlight during the year

prompt: Explain why boiling point changes with altitude.

correct_answer: Boiling point decreases at higher altitude because atmospheric pressure is lower so water reaches its vapor pressure at a lower temperature

prompt: Explain why randomized controlled trials are useful for testing whether a treatment works.
